evaluation.label: DLinear + PROSWIN-speed-assisted LightGBM · retrospective evaluation
evaluation.sample: 156 daily target timestamps per lead; horizons +1…+96h
notes: Density heads trained on 2011–2024; blend weights and interval calibration fitted on 2025. The 2026 period was previously inspected, not blind.
156 daily target timestamps per lead, not a full hourly replay. Image publication delays are omitted.
These retrospective scores do not measure live image availability or the deployed queue/cutoff policy. Missing-input fallback was tested separately.
Horizons +97–120h retain DLinear; this evaluation covers only +1–96h.
